lines.text: Barnaby the little bear loved eating sweet berries, crunchy honey-toast, and dried apples!
When bedtime arrived, Barnaby crawled under his quilt without visiting the bathroom sink!
Skipping brushing leaves tiny sugary crumbs wedged between teeth where germs party!
In his dream, tiny Sugar Bugs with little pickaxes began drilling holes in white enamel shields!
Barnaby woke up with a start, jumped out of bed, and reached for his superhero toothbrush!
Brush top teeth! Brush bottom teeth! Brush the chewing surfaces for two full minutes!
Frothy minty bubbles scrubbed every single sugar bug down the shiny drain pipe!
Brushing morning and night keeps your smile sparkling bright, fresh, and cavity-free!
Brush like a champion and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
